discovered.description: ASG Clips x Boxabl 🏠 Boxabl is revolutionizing real estate with affordable, factory-built homes. Create viral clips showcasing this game-changing tech strong hooks, clean edits, big energy. Top clippers get paid. Let's put housing's future on the map!

detail.guidelines:
Boxabl makes foldable, factory-built homes — flagship product is the Casita (20x20 ft, ships flat, unfolds on-site).
Clip only from the pre-approved BOXABL Content To Clip footage (factory tours/walkthroughs featuring creators like Enes Yilmazer, Orkun Isitmak, Elon Musk, Airrack, Faze Rug, etc).

Always show the WHOLE Boxabl home, not just one feature — think car review, show the whole car first.
Make it clear it's a BOXABL home — say it out loud or put "BOXABL" on screen.
Hook viewers in the first 2 seconds with a strong visual or recognizable face — no slow intros or logos.

Use bold text overlays/captions so the story works on mute.
Every post caption must mention Boxabl (Casita, foldable home, or factory) — never leave it blank or unrelated.
Tag @boxabl on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. On X, use a tracking URL instead of a tag.

Auto-captions must spell "BOXABL" correctly or the clip is rejected.
Positive vibes only — no mocking or negativity toward Boxabl, the product, or featured talent (including Post Malone, Elon, etc).
Don't post raw rips — footage must be edited (cuts, b-roll, overlays).
Vary your clips — don't repost the same moment repeatedly.
No clips of Kanye — instant rejection.
No story boosting.

Do not mention Boxabl stock or its trading ticker in any caption or post.
Optional: tag founder/CEO Galiano Tiramani (@GalianoTiramani on X or @box_pusher on Instagram).
Optional affiliate program for extra earnings — link at boxabl.com/affiliate (forms = $1 each, sales = 3% commission, referrals = 0.5%/$0.25 override).
detail.creator_description: Looking for clippers who can turn Boxabl's factory tour and celebrity walkthrough footage into scroll-stopping short-form content. You should be skilled at fast-paced editing, strong hooks, and bold text overlays. Interest in real estate, tech, or home innovation is a plus. Must follow brand attribution and caption rules closely — quality and consistency matter more than volume.
